credibility.line: Only one promise can be checked against reported numbers so far — too few to score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Revenue YoY growth accelerated from -0.0% in Sep 2025 to 14.5% in Sep 2026, validating management's growth trajectory.
Management guided 22.5%-23.5% EBITDA margin, but Sep 2026 reported EBITDA margin dropped to 22.0%.
Operating cash flow conversion deteriorated to 0.73 OCF/PAT in Mar 2026 from 1.11 in Mar 2025.

bull: Revenue YoY growth accelerated sharply from 5.7% in Dec 2025 to 14.5% in Sep 2026.
Strong return profile with ROCE of 28.4%, ROE of 31.0%, and minimal debt-to-equity ratio of 0.03.
Robust 5-year operating cash conversion averaging 104% of reported net profit.
bear: EBITDA margin dropped to 22.0% in Sep 2026, below the guided 22.5%-23.5% range.
Operating cash flow fell to Rs 10,999 crore in Mar 2026, lowering OCF/PAT to 0.73.
EBIT margin steadily declined from 21.7% in Sep 2025 to 20.4% in Sep 2026.
watch: EBITDA margin recovery into the guided 22.5%-23.5% range in Q3 FY27.
Cash flow conversion improvement back toward historical >1.0 OCF/PAT levels.
Sustainability of revenue growth following Sep 2026's 14.5% YoY performance.
